spec_match.rationale: Drives the real setFromBase64() with lastChunkHandling:'stop-before-partial' and surfaces the { read, written } contract per chunk — the streaming capability the proposal added it for.

interactive.rationale: Chunk size and alphabet controls re-run the decode; verified 16-byte → 4 chunks and 8-byte → 10 chunks with round-trip verification each time.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb describes exactly this: chunked decode into a pre-allocated buffer with read/written tracking.

edge_cases.rationale: Switching the encoding now re-encodes the same payload bytes with the selected alphabet (no artificial mismatch error); partial-final-chunk behavior — the reason stop-before-partial exists — still never occurs because the payload is always complete.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite passes live (setFromBase64 itself has no dedicated assertion — an additive one is possible; existing suite untouched).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless via CDP/puppeteer 2026-08-30 (feature natively supported — shipped Chrome 140): every button/sample/control driven, DOM readouts verified after each action, console clean (only sandbox-blocked external font fetch), zero page overflow at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3, full-page screenshots read. Guard added 2026-08-30 (extended to include toHex, which the chunk rows call): absent API now disables controls with an honest explanation instead of throwing an unhandled TypeError before first paint.

design_system.rationale: After review, amber/emerald column colours apply only on the black header row (5.9:1 / 5.1:1), data rows and summary highlights inherit charcoal (12+:1 on stone), and the summary's success mark is a black-on-emerald chip (5.1:1); the error mark is rose on stone (4.9:1); dark header keeps ivory text.

accessibility.rationale: Inputs labelled; the chunk log is a styled div grid with no table semantics and the summary is not a live region.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Zero overflow both classes; log scrolls vertically in its own container.

openQuestions.title: Demonstrate stop-before-partial on an actual partial chunk
openQuestions.detail: Feed the decoder a deliberately truncated slice (e.g. cut mid-quartet) and show read stopping before the partial group — that is the semantic the option name promises and the current always-complete payload never exercises.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo layout without horizontal overflow mobile touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Design tokens, adequate touch targets, visible focus, honest capability handling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Pages already use CSS variables throughout; verified zero page overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 for all six concepts; fixes kept the existing token-based styling.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP probe: documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth == 0 on all 6 concepts, both classes

guidanceConsulted.query: status message live region labelled form controls
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label controls; surface state changes as text; keep native elements for keyboard support.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Existing labels/aria-labels verified; remaining gaps (status bars not aria-live, hex cells click-only) recorded as open questions rather than silently passed.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: page source review + CDP interaction transcript 2026-08-30

summary: Streaming decode verified at two chunk sizes plus payload regeneration. FIXED 2026-08-30: page previously assumed the API existed (unhandled TypeError on pre-140 engines); it now feature-detects the exact setFromBase64/toBase64 pair and degrades honestly. [review follow-up 2026-08-30 #2] Codex: alphabet switch now re-encodes the payload instead of erroring; toHex added to the exact-surface guard; row/summary colours brought to AA.
